page: Google Cloud Platform n4-standard-64 is a general-purpose server instance featuring 64 vCPUs and 256 GB of RAM, configured with a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Powered by an Intel x86_64 processor with 32 physical cores and hyperthreading, it allocates dedicated CPU resources. The processor features a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory bandwidth, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 4103.87 GB/sec and uncached large block read speeds at 277.75 GB/sec. Multi-core performance is highly competitive, as evidenced by a strong Geekbench multi-core score of 17690.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 67610.19. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to strong performance in extended instructions, cryptography, and database operations.

This instance is well-suited for multi-threaded workloads such as software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and CPU-based LLM inference, where it demonstrates strong prompt processing capabilities. Given its high resource density and dedicated CPU allocation, it offers a balanced hardware profile for enterprise applications requiring consistent multi-core compute and high memory throughput without the added cost of specialized GPU or local storage hardware.
